families.decision: Organic, 100% grass-fed and grass-finished meat from a named local family farm.
buying_tips: Look for USDA Organic; prefer a Real Organic Project seal too.
Read '100% grass-fed and grass-finished' on the label or farm card.
Check for AGA certification or a farm statement of no grain through finishing.
Pick a named local family farm; skip a bare 'grass-fed' claim.

families.decision: Organic, pasture-raised poultry or pork from a named local family farm.
buying_tips: Look for USDA Organic and 'pasture-raised' on the meat label.
Pick a named local family farm on the pack or counter sign.
Read the farm card for pasture access and organic feed.

sources.name: Product-specific organic labels and pasture feeding

beef_grassfed_vs_grainfed.decision: 100% grass-fed and grass-finished organic beef, farm named.
beef_grassfed_vs_grainfed.delta: Look for liver or heart cuts alongside muscle cuts, where legally sold.

beef_cuts_basics.decision: Organic 100% grass-fed and grass-finished beef in whole cuts.
beef_cuts_basics.delta: Whole cuts; skip 'mechanically tenderized', 'needle tenderized' or 'blade tenderized'.

ground_beef_lean_ratio.decision: Look for 100% grass-fed and grass-finished beef, liver and heart blend where legally sold.
ground_beef_lean_ratio.delta: Liver and heart percentages on the ingredient list; lean/fat ratio is a separate number.

beef_veal.decision: Organic pasture-raised veal, mother's milk and grass stated on the farm label.
beef_veal.delta: Milk from its mother plus grass or hay; skip milk-replacer-fed veal.

pork_cuts_and_enhanced.decision: Organic pasture-raised pork, farm named, with no added solution.
pork_cuts_and_enhanced.delta: Skip 'contains added solution' and water or phosphates listed with the pork.

judging_meat_at_the_case.decision: Organic 100% grass-fed and grass-finished meat in sealed, leak-free packs.
judging_meat_at_the_case.delta: Intact wrap and seams; skip packs with punctures or broken vacuum seals.

butcher_counter_asking.decision: Ask for organic 100% grass-fed and grass-finished beef at the staffed counter.
butcher_counter_asking.delta: At the staffed counter, ask for a beef, liver and heart blend with written shares, where legally sold.

lamb_goat.decision: Organic pasture-raised lamb or goat, farm named, 100% grass-fed and grass-finished.
lamb_goat.delta: Lamb or goat named on the label; goat forage may include browse.

organ_meats.decision: Look for 100% grass-fed and grass-finished beef organs where legally sold.
organ_meats.delta: Beef liver or heart named as the cut; plain organ cuts alongside organ blends.

bison.decision: Organic 100% grass-fed and grass-finished bison from a named farm.
bison.delta: Read 'bison' as the sole meat ingredient; skip grinds blended with beef or pork.

venison_game.decision: Organic pasture-raised venison, farm named, with a grass-and-forage finish.
venison_game.delta: Read the deer species, such as red, fallow or sika; pick single-species cuts.

groups.title: Grass-finished beef, bison, lamb and goat
groups.why_same: The same organic, pasture, full grass finish and named-farm checks apply to these ruminants; species stays visible on the label.
